definition: A gene encoding a chromatin-modifying enzyme (lysine-specific demethylase 6B) in which heterozygous variants are causally linked to Stolerman neurodevelopmental syndrome (NEDSST; OMIM #618505).

source.title: Chromatin modifiers in neurodevelopment
